phrase: Add a NAME to your hand
reason: Leafshadow Assassin 10912110 binds the Fairy so Combo (3) can give that instance Bane; a lone add has no later clause to bind.

phrase: Deal N damage to all enemy followers
reason: Timepiece of Perfection 10762210 wraps the Enhance copy in seq so validate.mjs does not flag a mode that copies the Engage clause's damage subtree.
An instead-clause inherits its target from the card's base sentence (all enemies / all enemy followers / the selected follower), which the leftover printed does not repeat.
Ebb and Flow 10853310 binds the drawn cards so the super-evolution clause can reduce their costs; a lone draw has nothing to bind.
Blade of the Crestpetal 10541310 binds the drawn follower so X is that card's cost; Adventurers' Guild 10002210 draws with no later reference.
The numbered options are card-specific and carry their own printed nodes; this prompt is only the choose wrapper.

phrase: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it N damage
reason: Measured Attunement 10721310 binds the damaged follower so Rally (10) can give that instance Can't attack until the end of the opponent's turn.

Amorous Necromancer / Advent of the Eld Sword / Ferocious Commander bind the summoned copies so a later Super-Evolve or additive Enhance can give them Drain or stats; a lone summon has no later clause.
Zeta & Bea 10424110 and Mireille & Risette 10432120 bind the summoned copy so Enhance / Earth Rite can give it Bane or evolve it; a lone summon has no later clause.
Marionette Master 10571110 binds both puppets so Enhance (7) can give them Storm; Blade Puppeteer 10972120 has no later clause on those instances.

phrase: Whenever a NAME is destroyed, restore N defense to your leader
reason: Lifestealer 10553110 prints "a Skeleton" with no side, so both ally_follower_destroyed and enemy_follower_destroyed are required (docs/schema.md Events).

phrase: Whenever an allied Marine follower attacks, give it +N/+N until the end of the turn and, once on each of your turns, add a NAME to your hand
reason: Yube's crest is one printed sentence with two triggers (always-buff vs once-per-your-turn add), so the same phrase is two abilities.
On a when-enter ability "it" is pick:entering; on Obsessed Test Subject 10931110 the enter-route subject is pick:self (owner 2026-08-30 named_enter_count).
